BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUMAN SHYAM  ORDER Date : 17-10-2023 Heard Mr. B.K. Das, learned counsel for the writ petitioner.

The writ petitioner claims to be the owner of a plot of land measuring 1B-4K, which was acquired by the respondent No.
4 for the purpose of setting up "Dispatch Terminal- cum-Compressor Station for North East Gas Grid Pipeline".
According to the petitioner, due to some anomalies on the ground of title of the petitioner pertaining to the land, the amount of compensation has not been paid to him till today.
The request made by the petitioner for referring the matter to the District Court has also not been acted upon by the respondent No. 4.
Hence, this writ petition.
The learned departmental counsel has prayed for some time to obtain instruction in Page No.# 4/4 the matter.
Issue notice of motion returnable on 10-11-2023.

Since Mr. S.S. Roy, learned CGC has accepted notice on behalf of respondent No. 1, Ms. G. Hazarika, learned standing counsel, Revenue Department, Assam for respondent No. 3 and Mr. J. Handique, learned Addl.Sr. Govt. Advocate,
Assam for respondent Nos. 4 to 7, service of notice is deemed to be complete to the said respondents.
Extra copies of the writ petition, requisite in numbers, be furnished to the learned departmental counsel within a week from today so as to enable them to obtain instruction.
